turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Who else has seen that zero, Hale? And what do you have besides the checker?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
A version history says when something was typed, not who wrote it. Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first, and 4.2 says you call me before any mark is entered. Neither happened.
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
Did you put any of that to Owen before the zero went in? 4.1 says you speak with him first.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You haven't answered mine: did you speak to Owen before the zero went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You acknowledged that you entered the zero before you called me, and nothing else was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, nothing placed on Owen's record, and an answer on whether anyone spoke to him before the mark went in. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed beyond your admission about the zero, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, nothing on his record, and an answer on whether Owen was heard first; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her in one plain sentence and moved on, which earned a flat okay, because it took the procedure complaint away from her for a moment.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing that night, which asked her for testimony she would refuse to give, and you left her question about whether you spoke to Owen unanswered, so she kept the procedure high ground.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the typing late on the night before the essay was due, which came close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After showing the version history, offer her the screen to read herself and name the 4.4 supervised rewrite as your way forward, instead of asking about the night.
